articles.summary: Stewart Information Services Corporation (NYSE: STC) announced today it will hold a conference call to discuss third quarter 2026 earnings at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time on Thursday, October 22, 2026. The call will follow the company’s release of earnings after the close of trading on Wednesday, October 21. Individuals wishing to participate can dial (833) 419-0865 (USA) and (785) 838-9333 (International) – access code STCQ326. The conference call replay will be available from 11 a.m. Eastern Time on October 22, 2026, until midnight on October 29, 2026, by dialing (800) 839-5241 (USA) or (402) 220-2698 (International). Additionally, participants can listen to the conference call through STC’s Investor Relations website at https://investors.stewart.com/news-and-events/events/default.aspx . About Stewart Stewart (NYSE-STC) is a global real estate services company, offering products and services through our direct operations, network of Stewart Trusted Providers™ and family of companies.
